newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA INTERBANK MARKET RATES (CHIBOR) MIXED.
newsitem.headline: CHINA INTERBANK MARKET RATES (CHIBOR) MIXED.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 1.061 billion yuan from 1.471 billion yuan with the one-day contract the most actively traded.
Dealers said activity was dull on the first-tier market, used for trading by state banks and short-term financial centres, which are money brokerages run by the central bank.
"Few first-tier members traded today," a trader said.

But in second-tier trading, where non-banking financial institutions trade through the short-term financial centres, activity was lively with securities houses borrowing heavily due to a surge on the domestic A share markets on Thursday.
Non-banking institutions are allowed to borrow only through the one-day contract, which made it the most actively traded contract on Thursday, traders said.
Traders said rates were likely to move narrowly on Friday.
